changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard capitalization. Added more specific descriptions of the outputs beyond just generated responses.

Removed duplicate/long-form variants (ECE-t, BS-t are not fundamentally different metrics but temperature-scaled versions). Simplified to base metric names. Added NLL which was mentioned as part of temperature scaling procedure.
Consolidated GPT-3.5 references to GPT-3.5-turbo (consistent with document terminology). Normalized method name. The paper consistently uses GPT-4 and GPT-3.5-turbo for equivalence checking.

Cleaned up empty/null values to empty arrays. The paper mentions a human survey (Fagen-Ulmschneider, 2023) for mapping linguistic expressions to probabilities, but this is not an evaluation of the generated outputs - it's external data used to map likelihood expressions.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. Main changes were normalization of capitalization and removal of redundant metric variants. The paper focuses on confidence calibration in question answering tasks across major RLHF models. It uses LLMs for correctness evaluation but does not conduct human evaluations of the generated outputs.
